title: Luxury Nash! Priv Game Room! Rooftop! 6 Min to DT!
description:
WELCOME TO LUXURY NASHVILLE!!--Just minutes away from Downtown Nashville and Nissan Stadium! This Huge Luxury Home has been designed perfect for a group of friends or families! Enjoy the Private Game Room Lounge with a pool table, basketball arcade game, beer pong table, and Sound System! Or, Enjoy the rooftop Nashville Skyline views while using the Karaoke Machine and Bar Cart! Many comfortable beds, modern stand-up showers, and professional cleanings! A Great Time in Nashville starts here!

The space
WELCOME TO COMFORT & LUXURY!

This luxury 2250 SQFT , 4 Bed, 4.5 Bath Single Family Home is located 6 minutes from Downtown Nashville and Nissan Stadium in a upscale neighborhood close to the heart of all there is to do in Nashville!  

NOTE: This property has three flight of stairs, which is typical in Nashville for New, Modern Single Family Homes. It also is close to a highway, which may create some noise at nights, although we have provided white noise and complimentary ear plugs if it ever does.

This spacious, luxury residence offers:

*Comfortable High-End Sleeping Options For All 🛌🏼:
(7) Seven Queen Beds
(1) One King Bed
(1) One King Sized Pull Out Sofa Bed
(1) One Queen Sized Pull Out Sofa Bed
(1) 1 Single Chaise Sofa

*Private Game Room Speakeasy Lounge with:
-Tournament Size Pool Table
-Beer Pong Table (cups and balls included)
-Basketball Arcade Game
-Comfortable Seating and Music

*Complimentary Scented Shampoo, Conditioner, and Body Wash

*Complimentary Full Coffee Stand (Keurig Coffee, Sugar, and Creamer ☕ (NOTE: the snack bar is not complimentary)

*High End & Convenient Snack Bar (Chocolate Bars, Gatorade, Monster Drinks, Red Bull, Soda, Protein Bars, Beef Jerky, Trail Mix, Chips, and More!) 🍪🍭🍫🍵🥤 **NOTE: this will be billed per menu listed at the end of your stay.

*Private Rooftop with Downtown Nashville Skyline Views with furniture 🏙️

*Fun Group Games 🎲

*Karaoke Machine with Two Microphones and lots of popular Karaoke songs (limited to YouTube Karaoke Song Selection) 🎤 🎶

*High Speed AT&T Wifi 📶

*70-75 inch Smart TVs with Disney+ and Hulu streaming apps included 📺

*Soft Pool Towels and Towels 🧼

*Makeup Towels and Disposable Wipes 💄

*Johnny Cash and Taylor Swift and other Vinyl Record Player with Bluetooth Capability 💽

*100% Blackout Curtains for a Comfortable Night's Sleep 💤

*Full kitchen with Stainless Steel Appliances, Microwave, and Toaster 🍴

*Free On-Site Parking for up to four (4) cars🚗

*Washer/Dryer Inside the Unit 🧦

*Iron and Ironing Board

*Hair Dryer 🪮

*Cleaning Supplies 🧽🧹

*Fun For Parties Bar Cart 🍷🍻

*Sky Lounge with Billiard Table 🎱

*Work Station Lounge and social gathering place 💼

STR Permit Number: T2026041224

Guest access
The entire home and exterior can be used by guests!
